# Installation of INFUSE

INFUSE is an R package hosted on GitHub. It can be installed using `devtools`:

```r
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("gchen4422/INFUSE")
```

After installation, load the package:

```r
library(INFUSE)
```

## Dependencies

INFUSE depends on the following R packages, which will be installed automatically:

| Package | Purpose |
|:---|:---|
| `Rcpp` | C++ integration for compiled backend code |
| `RcppArmadillo` | Linear algebra backend (Armadillo) for compiled code |
| `R6` | Object-oriented classes used in the INFUSE model implementation |
| `progress` | Progress bar display during iterative optimization |
| `nloptr` | Numerical optimization for prior-variance estimation |
| `elasticnet` | Sparse PCA via `spca()` for the `mlk` annotation method |
| `glmnet` | Penalized regression for the `glm` annotation method |
| `Matrix` | Sparse/block-diagonal matrix operations (used in `kriging_rss_joint`) |
| `ggplot2` | Diagnostic plot output from `kriging_rss_joint` |
| `mixsqp` | Mixture model fitting for the LD-discrepancy log-likelihood ratio |
